results.title: SYSTEM_ADMIN (Platform) → create tenant admin of a new tenant (+ workspace) → activation link → activate → login Admin portal

checks.name: [api] SYSTEM_ADMIN creates a NEW tenant (201, no first admin yet)
[api] …and a workspace OF THAT TENANT through the tenant route (201, tenantId explicit)
the SYSTEM_ADMIN logs in through the Platform portal
the dialog: four sections, a tenant selector, NO not-ready notice, NO SYSTEM_ADMIN type
the workspace of the chosen tenant is offered (optional; assigned here)
checks.detail: options=6 (H-C1-16: /admin/workspaces is not filtered by tenant; the dialog lists its first page)

checks.name: POST /admin/tenants/{tenantId}/users → 201; the tenant is the PATH, never in the body; tenantRole TENANT_ADMIN; workspaceId + workspaceRole together; no password
the activation link is shown once in the dialog (/auth/activate#token); no password anywhere
after 'Xong' the token is gone: not in the summary, the URL, localStorage or sessionStorage
the summary: Chờ kích hoạt, the company AND its role already assigned, the workspace; the only next step is the person's activation
[api] the server lists the account as TENANT_ADMIN of the new tenant (already, before activation)
CSRF + body: the create-account request carries X-XSRF-TOKEN and its body has no tenant / tenantId; no browser request to the legacy workspace route
[api] the same username again is refused: 409 USERNAME_TAKEN
the new admin activates through the REAL activation page
[api] after activation /auth/me lists the chosen workspace with MEMBER_MANAGE (WORKSPACE_ADMIN, from the server) and the tenant TENANT_MEMBERS
…and logs in through the ADMIN portal: not refused
…sees Công ty của tôi and Người dùng, not the system-wide sections
checks.detail: Tổng quan | Người dùng | Công ty của tôi | Workspace của tôi | Nguồn dữ liệu | Nhóm | Chia sẻ | AI riêng của công ty

checks.name: no unexpected 4xx/5xx from the portal's calls
no unhandled page errors

results.title: Tenant admin (Admin portal) → Người dùng → create workspace admin + app creator by invitation → activation → the creator can sign in

checks.name: the tenant admin logs in through the ADMIN portal
navigation has Người dùng and Công ty của tôi
checks.detail: Tổng quan | Người dùng | Công ty của tôi | Nhóm | Chia sẻ | AI riêng của công ty

checks.name: Người dùng: the tenant is the SESSION's (read-only), the create action is enabled, no not-ready notice
the dialog: NO tenant selector (fixed, read-only tenant), the types never include SYSTEM_ADMIN (tenant admin may be offered)
the workspace is created through the TENANT route (POST /admin/tenants/{tenant}/workspaces → 201, tenantId = the session's tenant) — never the legacy POST /admin/workspaces
the workspace request body is exactly {name}: the tenant id is the PATH only, never repeated in the body
POST /admin/tenants/{tenant}/users → 201 with tenantRole MEMBER, that workspace and WORKSPACE_ADMIN together; the tenant only in the path
the activation link is shown once (/auth/activate#token)
the summary shows account, Chờ kích hoạt, the company and the workspace with its role; the token is gone from the page
the workspace admin activates through the REAL activation page
[api] the workspace admin signs in; /auth/me lists the new workspace with MEMBER_MANAGE (server permission, not a role name)
[observed] is the workspace the tenant admin just created offered to it for the next account? (H-C1-16: a tenant admin is not a member of it; /auth/me lists member workspaces only)
the app creator is created (201): MEMBER, email as given, workspace + role together or none
the app creator activates through the REAL activation page
workspace assignment of an EXISTING tenant member is the WORKSPACE ADMIN's action: POST /workspaces/{w}/members → 201
[api] the app creator signs in with the chosen password; /auth/me lists the workspace and no MEMBER_MANAGE / TENANT_*
the app creator is NOT admitted to the Admin portal (no admin capability from the server)
LEGACY ROUTE: 0 browser requests to POST /api/v1/admin/workspaces in the whole tenant-admin flow; the workspace went to POST /api/v1/admin/tenants/{tenantId}/workspaces
CSRF: every mutating admin request the UI sent carries the X-XSRF-TOKEN header
no tenantId / tenant in any body the UI sent to a tenant route
no unexpected 4xx/5xx from the portal's calls
no unhandled page errors

results.title: App creator (EDITOR, made by the tenant admin): Studio login → project visible → edit / save / reload → permissions are the role's
results.reason: the Studio portal refuses this creator at login (/auth/no-access) although /auth/me lists the workspace with []. The API side of the same account works (project APIs, edit, persist, no publish). H-C1-04 (still open).

checks.name: [api] the workspace admin creates a project in the new workspace (201)
[api] …and adds the creator to the project as EDITOR (member route)
[api] the creator's resolved project permissions include APP_EDIT and NOT APP_PUBLISH
[api] …and no MEMBER_MANAGE: /auth/me lists none in the workspace
[api] an edit by the creator is accepted (200)
after a reload the edit is still there (persisted)
[api] publishing is refused for the creator (403): the role is the role
no unhandled page errors

results.title: SEC01 tenant admin cannot create SYSTEM_ADMIN · SEC02 cross-tenant is a safe 404 · SEC03 workspace admin cannot escalate

checks.name: SEC01 [api] tenantRole SYSTEM_ADMIN is refused (400 TENANT_ROLE_INVALID)
SEC01 [api] unknown fields (systemAdmin, platformScope, role) never take effect: the account is a plain, non-admin MEMBER
SEC01 [api] the legacy platform route is closed to a tenant admin (403 ADMIN_REQUIRED)
SEC01 [api] …cannot grant SYSTEM_ADMIN to anyone nor to itself (403)
SEC01 [api] nobody became a SYSTEM_ADMIN
SEC01 [api] the tenant admin's /auth/me carries no platform scope
SEC02 [api] tenant A's admin gets 404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND on every tenant-B route (create user, create workspace, members, candidates, add self, re-role, remove, read)
checks.detail: createUser=404/TENANT_NOT_FOUND createWs=404/TENANT_NOT_FOUND members=404/TENANT_NOT_FOUND candidates=404/TENANT_NOT_FOUND setRole=404/TENANT_NOT_FOUND reRole=404/TENANT_NOT_FOUND remove=404/TENANT_NOT_FOUND tenant=404/TENANT_NOT_FOUND

checks.name: SEC02 [api] …and the refused create left nothing behind (no account named like it)
SEC02 [api] a workspace of ANOTHER tenant in my tenant's create → 404 WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND, and no account is created
SEC02 [api] …and the other way round (B's admin on tenant A): 404
SEC02 [api] neither tenant admin can list the system-wide users or workspaces (403)
SEC02 [api] each tenant's member list holds only its own people

SEC03 [api] a workspace admin cannot call the tenant routes (create user / workspace, candidates, members, make itself tenant admin) → 403, nor platform routes (legacy create, system-admin, new tenant, suspend)
checks.detail: createUser=403/FORBIDDEN createWs=403/FORBIDDEN candidates=403/FORBIDDEN members=403/FORBIDDEN selfTenant=403/FORBIDDEN legacyUser=403/ADMIN_REQUIRED sysAdmin=403/ADMIN_REQUIRED newTenant=403/ADMIN_REQUIRED suspend=403/ADMIN_REQUIRED

checks.name: SEC03 [api] …with the codes of the contract (FORBIDDEN on tenant routes, ADMIN_REQUIRED on platform routes)
SEC03 [api] …cannot change its own workspace role (403 SELF_GRANT_FORBIDDEN)
SEC03 [api] …cannot read, nor add itself to, a workspace of another tenant (403/404)
SEC03 [api] …cannot pull a person of ANOTHER tenant into its workspace (404 USER_NOT_FOUND)
SEC03 [api] nothing changed: still a plain tenant MEMBER, not a SYSTEM_ADMIN, the tenant still ACTIVE
401 [api] an unauthenticated caller (valid CSRF, no session) is refused on create user / create workspace / list members: 401
401 [api] …and nothing was created (no account named like it)
CSRF [api] an authenticated mutating request WITHOUT the CSRF header, or with a wrong one, is refused (403) and does nothing
CSRF [api] the same request WITH the session's CSRF token succeeds (201): the refusal above was the missing token, not the route
body injection [api] a foreign tenant id in the BODY (tenantId / tenant) is ignored: the path is the authority — the account is a member of tenant A, not of B
body injection [api] …and a workspace created with a foreign tenantId in the body belongs to tenant A (the path)
